champion.tips: FIZZ TIPS AND TRICKS Try and go for extended trades as frequently as possible. Focus on using your Q and W to trade with while holding on to your E to escape with. Spend your mid-game split pushing and duelling enemies who try to stop you. If you need to group, flank from the side with your Ultimate R . If you can't pick up kills in the mid lane, look to roam with your Ultimate R .
champion.builds: THE BEST FIZZ BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR MID IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Fizz Mid build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Electrocute as your keystone, followed by Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Scorch and Transcendence in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Lich Bane as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Zhonya's Hourglass. For your last 3 items, you should build Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff and finish with Shadowflame. For the skill order, you want to stick with E - W - Q. Right now, this build has 52.4% winrate over 15 230 matches played. Optional Your second option for Fizz Mid build would be to take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Electrocute as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter in the primary tree, and Scorch with Transcendence in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Luden's Companion, which you should build first, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item and Lich Bane as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Zhonya's Hourglass, Rabadon's Deathcap and Void Staff. The skill order for this build is E - W - Q. In the current patch, this build has a 51.8% win rate over 3 251 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Electrocute as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter in the primary tree, and Triumph with Legend: Haste in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Blackfire Torch as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Zhonya's Hourglass as a third item. You want to finish the build with Lich Bane, Rabadon's Deathcap and Void Staff. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it E - W - Q. This build is currently sitting at a 53.8% win rate across 1 158 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Fizz Mid build in the current patch, try Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, Dark Harvest, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter as your primary rune tree, and Coup de Grace with Triumph as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Lich Bane as your first item, then finish Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item, and Shadowflame as third item. The last 3 options are Zhonya's Hourglass, Rabadon's Deathcap and Void Staff. The ability order for this build is E - W - Q. As of the current patch, this build has a 55.8% win rate over 242 matches played. Situational Fizz Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Fizz build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Fizz runes page.
